run_merge_traj: run the merge_traj script to merge VASP checkpoint trajectories into a single full trajectory file
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using extract_file
merge_checkpoints_to_trajectory: merge intermediate VASP relaxation checkpoints into a single ASE trajectory file for an adsorbate run
read_vasp_xml_trajectory: read VASP vasprun.xml files and construct a full ASE trajectory using ase.io
review_merge_traj_main: review the main function that loops through adsorbate directories and merges checkpoint trajectories
